views.name: v_conversation_oversight
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS conversation_id,
    c.kind,
    c.name,
    c.description,
    c.pod_id,
    c.cohort_id,
    c.audience,
    c.last_message_at,
    lm.body AS last_message_body,
    lm.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id,
    lm.created_at AS last_message_created_at,
    lm.deleted_at AS last_message_deleted_at,
    lm.deleted_by AS last_message_deleted_by,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM conversation_participants cp
          WHERE cp.conversation_id = c.id AND cp.user_id = auth.uid() AND cp.left_at IS NULL)) AS i_am_active_participant
   FROM conversations c
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.id,
            m.body,
            m.sender_id,
            m.created_at,
            m.deleted_at,
            m.deleted_by
           FROM messages m
          WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id
          ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) lm ON true;

views.name: v_conversation_summary
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS conversation_id,
    c.kind,
    c.name,
    c.description,
    c.pod_id,
    c.cohort_id,
    c.audience,
    c.last_message_at,
    cp.can_message AS my_can_message,
    cp.last_read_at AS my_last_read_at,
        CASE
            WHEN lm.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN NULL::text
            ELSE lm.body
        END AS last_message_body,
    lm.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id,
    lm.created_at AS last_message_created_at,
    lm.deleted_at AS last_message_deleted_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM messages m2
          WHERE m2.conversation_id = c.id AND m2.created_at > COALESCE(cp.last_read_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND m2.sender_id <> auth.uid() AND m2.deleted_at IS NULL) AS unread_count,
    ( SELECT array_agg(u.full_name) AS array_agg
           FROM conversation_participants cp2
             JOIN users u ON u.id = cp2.user_id
          WHERE cp2.conversation_id = c.id AND cp2.user_id <> auth.uid() AND cp2.left_at IS NULL) AS other_participant_names
   FROM conversations c
     JOIN conversation_participants cp ON cp.conversation_id = c.id AND cp.user_id = auth.uid()
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.id,
            m.body,
            m.sender_id,
            m.created_at,
            m.deleted_at
           FROM messages m
          WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id
          ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) lm ON true
  WHERE cp.left_at IS NULL;

views.name: v_escalations
views.definition:
SELECT id AS exit_survey_id,
    subject_user_id,
    user_id AS reported_by,
    signal,
    follow_up_urgency,
    needs_follow_up,
    concern_tags,
    created_at
   FROM exit_surveys es
  WHERE reviewed_at IS NULL AND (needs_follow_up = true OR signal = 'red'::exit_survey_signal OR (follow_up_urgency = ANY (ARRAY['soon'::exit_survey_urgency, 'urgent'::exit_survey_urgency])));

views.name: v_exit_survey_context
views.definition:
SELECT es.id AS exit_survey_id,
    p.id AS pod_id,
    p.name AS pod_name,
    COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT mu.full_name) AS array_agg
           FROM pod_members mpm
             JOIN users mu ON mu.id = mpm.user_id AND mu.role = 'mentor'::user_role
          WHERE mpm.pod_id = p.id), '{}'::text[]) AS mentor_names
   FROM exit_surveys es
     LEFT JOIN pod_members pm ON pm.user_id = es.subject_user_id
     LEFT JOIN pods p ON p.id = pm.pod_id;

views.name: v_mentee_assignment_status
views.definition:
SELECT ma.id AS mentee_assignment_id,
    ma.assignment_id,
    ma.mentee_id,
    ma.due_at,
    ma.is_completed,
    count(DISTINCT s.id) AS total_slots,
    count(DISTINCT ms.slot_id) FILTER (WHERE ms.status = 'approved'::submission_status) AS approved_slots,
    count(DISTINCT ms.slot_id) FILTER (WHERE ms.status = 'pending_review'::submission_status) AS pending_slots,
    count(DISTINCT ms.slot_id) FILTER (WHERE ms.status = 'revision_requested'::submission_status) AS revision_slots,
        CASE
            WHEN count(DISTINCT s.id) = 0 THEN 'no_slots'::text
            WHEN count(DISTINCT ms.slot_id) FILTER (WHERE ms.status = 'approved'::submission_status) = count(DISTINCT s.id) THEN 'completed'::text
            WHEN count(DISTINCT ms.slot_id) FILTER (WHERE ms.status = 'pending_review'::submission_status) > 0 THEN 'pending_review'::text
            WHEN count(DISTINCT ms.slot_id) FILTER (WHERE ms.status = 'revision_requested'::submission_status) > 0 THEN 'needs_revision'::text
            ELSE 'not_started'::text
        END AS completion_status
   FROM mentee_assignments ma
     LEFT JOIN assignment_submission_slots s ON s.assignment_id = ma.assignment_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ms_1.slot_id) ms_1.slot_id,
            ms_1.status
           FROM mentee_submissions ms_1
          WHERE ms_1.mentee_assignment_id = ma.id
          ORDER BY ms_1.slot_id, ms_1.version_number DESC) ms ON true
  GROUP BY ma.id, ma.assignment_id, ma.mentee_id, ma.due_at, ma.is_completed;

views.name: v_mentor_stats
views.definition:
WITH mentor_pods AS (
         SELECT up.user_id AS mentor_id,
            up.pod_id
           FROM v_user_pods up
          WHERE up.role = 'mentor'::user_role
        ), mentee_pods AS (
         SELECT up.user_id AS mentee_id,
            up.pod_id
           FROM v_user_pods up
          WHERE up.role = 'mentee'::user_role
        ), mentor_mentees AS (
         SELECT mp.mentor_id,
            mep.mentee_id
           FROM mentor_pods mp
             JOIN mentee_pods mep ON mep.pod_id = mp.pod_id
        ), assignment_rollup AS (
         SELECT mm.mentor_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vas.completion_status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_assignments,
            count(*) AS total_assignments
           FROM mentor_mentees mm
             JOIN v_mentee_assignment_status vas ON vas.mentee_id = mm.mentee_id
          GROUP BY mm.mentor_id
        ), escalation_rollup AS (
         SELECT mm.mentor_id,
            count(*) AS open_escalations
           FROM mentor_mentees mm
             JOIN v_escalations ve ON ve.subject_user_id = mm.mentee_id
          GROUP BY mm.mentor_id
        )
 SELECT u.id AS mentor_id,
    u.full_name AS mentor_name,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM mentor_mentees mm
          WHERE mm.mentor_id = u.id) AS mentee_count,
    COALESCE(ar.completed_assignments, 0::bigint) AS completed_assignments,
    COALESCE(ar.total_assignments, 0::bigint) AS total_assignments,
    COALESCE(er.open_escalations, 0::bigint) AS open_escalations_among_mentees
   FROM users u
     LEFT JOIN assignment_rollup ar ON ar.mentor_id = u.id
     LEFT JOIN escalation_rollup er ON er.mentor_id = u.id
  WHERE u.role = 'mentor'::user_role AND u.deleted_at IS NULL;

views.name: v_pending_exit_surveys
views.definition:
SELECT es.id AS exit_survey_id,
    es.user_id,
    es.subject_user_id,
    es.meeting_id,
    m.title,
    m.starts_at,
    m.ends_at,
    m.status AS meeting_status,
    su.full_name AS subject_full_name
   FROM exit_surveys es
     JOIN meetings m ON m.id = es.meeting_id
     LEFT JOIN users su ON su.id = es.subject_user_id
  WHERE es.submitted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND now() >= (m.starts_at + (m.ends_at - m.starts_at) * 0.8::double precision);

views.name: v_pod_stats
views.definition:
WITH pod_roster AS (
         SELECT p.id AS pod_id,
            p.name AS pod_name,
            p.cohort_id,
            up.user_id,
            up.role
           FROM pods p
             JOIN v_user_pods up ON up.pod_id = p.id
          WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
        ), assignment_rollup AS (
         SELECT pr_1.pod_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vas.completion_status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_assignments,
            count(*) AS total_assignments
           FROM pod_roster pr_1
             JOIN v_mentee_assignment_status vas ON vas.mentee_id = pr_1.user_id
          WHERE pr_1.role = 'mentee'::user_role
          GROUP BY pr_1.pod_id
        ), escalation_rollup AS (
         SELECT pr_1.pod_id,
            count(*) AS open_escalations
           FROM pod_roster pr_1
             JOIN v_escalations ve ON ve.subject_user_id = pr_1.user_id
          GROUP BY pr_1.pod_id
        )
 SELECT pr.pod_id,
    pr.pod_name,
    pr.cohort_id,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.role = 'mentee'::user_role) AS mentee_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.role = 'mentor'::user_role) AS mentor_count,
    COALESCE(ar.completed_assignments, 0::bigint) AS completed_assignments,
    COALESCE(ar.total_assignments, 0::bigint) AS total_assignments,
    COALESCE(er.open_escalations, 0::bigint) AS open_escalations
   FROM pod_roster pr
     LEFT JOIN assignment_rollup ar ON ar.pod_id = pr.pod_id
     LEFT JOIN escalation_rollup er ON er.pod_id = pr.pod_id
  GROUP BY pr.pod_id, pr.pod_name, pr.cohort_id, ar.completed_assignments, ar.total_assignments, er.open_escalations;

views.name: v_user_pods
views.definition:
SELECT u.id AS user_id,
    u.full_name,
    u.email,
    u.school_or_org,
    u.role,
    u.approval_status,
    u.created_at,
    pm.pod_id,
    p.name AS pod_name,
    p.cohort_id
   FROM users u
     LEFT JOIN pod_members pm ON pm.user_id = u.id
     LEFT JOIN pods p ON p.id = pm.pod_id
  WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL;

policies.with_check_expression:

   FROM conversation_participants cp
  WHERE ((cp.conversation_id = messages.conversation_id) AND (cp.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (cp.left_at IS NULL) AND (cp.can_message = true)))))

policies.using_expression:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM conversation_participants cp
  WHERE ((cp.conversation_id = messages.conversation_id) AND (cp.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (cp.left_at IS NULL)))) OR is_staff(auth.uid()))

search_conversation_messages
functions.definition:
SELECT m.*
  FROM public.messages m
  WHERE m.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
    AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND m.body ILIKE '%' || p_query || '%'
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.conversation_participants cp
        WHERE cp.conversation_id = m.conversation_id
          AND cp.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND cp.left_at IS NULL
      )
      OR public.is_staff(auth.uid())
    )
  ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 100;
